newsitem.title: USA: Orion Capital sets two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Orion Capital sets two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Orion Capital Corp said on Thursday that its directors had approved a two-for-one stock split of the company's common stock to shareholders of record on June 23.
"The stock split makes Orion's shares more affordable and should prove beneficial to our trading liquidity," said Orion chief executive Marston Becker.
Ceritificates representing the new shares will be issued on July 7, Orion said. The split raises the number of shares outstanding to roughly 27.5 million from the current level of about 13.8 million.
